card.name: Glycogen and glucose in warnings
card.fires_on: The word piece "Gly" in "Hepatic Glycogen" and the word "glucose" in "glucose-6-phosphate dehydrogenase", in warnings about patient conditions.

modes.label: Hepatic glycogen
modes.description: The start of "glycogen" after "Decreased Hepatic" in a heading on lack of efficacy.

modes.label: Glucose-6-phosphate
modes.description: The word "glucose" after "patients with" when it begins the enzyme deficiency name.

card.plain: It fires on sugar-related words that start a named condition, like low liver glycogen or G6PD deficiency.
